name: @warmdrift/kgauto-check
description: Communicating Vessels — the check. Your coding agent lists where your project calls an AI model (ids and counts, never code); this tool reads that list on your machine against the providers' own deprecation pages, read in each run, and a bundled catalog of model limits and prices. Nothing about your project leaves your machine unless you pass --share.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-stdio.mjs && node scripts/smoke-cli.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
